text: {"lessons":["Judge each holding by its forward outlook and portfolio role, not by whether it is above or below my average cost; losses alone do not justify selling, and gains alone do not justify holding.","Avoid buying more simply because a stock has risen or fallen. Recheck the thesis, valuation, and concentration, and keep enough cash to manage risk.","Large monthly swings and painful losses show that position sizing matters: limit exposure to any one stock and make deliberate, evidence-based trades rather than reacting to short-term moves."]}
